ptr.note: size bytes whose ownership moves to the new AVBuffer on success (released by free(opaque, data), or av_free when free is NULL); untouched on failure (NULL return). Never dereferenced by av_buffer_create itself; NULL is stored as is (fine with size 0). Writes go through it later only while the reference is writable, so READONLY data is never written by C. Rust: a HeapVec<u8> (default free) or the slice of a boxed Rust owner T: AsMut<[u8]>/AsRef<[u8]> (+ Send + 'static), or T: AsMut<[MaybeUninit<u8>]> for UninitBuffer::from_owner, whose bytes may be left uninitialised (pool allocators); UninitBuffer::try_from refuses any buffer with an opaque, since an initialised owner's drop may read its bytes.

free(opaque, data), stored in AVBuffer.free (NULL selects av_buffer_default_free) and called once by whichever thread drops the last reference (buffer_replace); for pool buffers, by buffer_pool_flush when the entry is flushed. Rust: NULL for HeapVec data, or release_owner::<T> (drops the Box<T> passed as opaque).

User state stored in AVBuffer.opaque, handed to free and returned by av_buffer_get_opaque; never dereferenced by C. Owned by the buffer when free releases it (Rust: the leaked Box<T>), else borrowed for the buffer's life. Untouched on failure.

A new reference (refcount 1) to an av_mallocz'd AVBuffer over data, released by av_buffer_unref; NULL on allocation failure, with data, free and opaque untouched. Writable unless flags has AV_BUFFER_FLAG_READONLY. Rust: BufferReference::from_heap_vec / from_owner / from_read_only, UninitBuffer::from_owner.
